summary: Phases 8-11 Backend Testing Complete - All 52 tests passed, 3 skipped. Search, SEO, Subscription/Billing, and Governance APIs fully functional. Subscription enforcement middleware correctly blocks writes (402) for canceled subscriptions while allowing reads.
critical_code_review_comments: Phase 8 Search: Community-scoped search works correctly with type filters (all/discussions/events/members). Non-members get 403. Query min length (2 chars) enforced.
Phase 9 SEO: Auto-generation works for community/discussion/event entities. Schema.org JSON-LD includes breadcrumbs. Manual override via PATCH, reset via DELETE. Redirects endpoint functional.
Phase 10 Plans: Full CRUD working. Duplicate name+cycle rejected. Cannot delete plan with active subscriptions.

Phase 10 Subscriptions: State machine transitions working (trial→active→paused→active, cancel from any state). Trial extension works. Mark-paid offline works. Audit logs track all actions with previous/new status.
Phase 11 Governance: Branding limits, media cleanup, and system integrity check all working. System check reports orphaned memberships, expired trials, and expired billing.

Phase 11 Subscription Enforcement: Middleware correctly blocks POST/PATCH/DELETE on community routes when subscription is canceled/expired (returns 402). GET requests pass through. Admin routes exempt.
RBAC: All /api/admin/* routes require super admin (403 for non-admin). Search requires membership. SEO updates require community manager.
seed_data_creation: Created test plans (cleaned up after tests). Test subscriptions created and state transitions tested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phases 8-11 fully tested. Key findings: (1) event-test community has CANCELED subscription - writes blocked with 402. (2) private-notif community subscription also canceled. (3) All admin billing/governance routes require super admin. (4) Search requires community membership. (5) SEO updates require community manager. (6) Subscription enforcement middleware auto-expires trials when trial_end_date passes.
